title: Elite: Choir Vault Ascension: Ascension Seal
description: Choir Vault Ascension unfolds across upper choir gate where song, law, and Hollow silence collide, pushing a 5-Titan Empyrean squad to prove protection, order-locks, shields, anti-chaos control, formationless aura play. without violating established Realm canon.
lore: Choir Vault Ascension: Ascension Seal advances Empyrean Choir Vault: The Radiant Hierarchies ascend a broken heaven-engine where order can stabilize worlds or erase dissonant survivors. It directly tests the faction tension: Their mercy is real, but so is their judgment. Allies fear becoming evidence in an Empyrean trial.
terrain: upper choir gate where song, law, and Hollow silence collide

objectives.primary: Defeat the chapter threat and preserve the faction doctrine under pressure. Elite remix: complete it while the secondary hazard condition is active.
